description: Benin - An Indicative Least-cost Geospatial Electrification Plan is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Policies and plans, Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Kartoza/KTH-dES/SNV/WorldBank/ESMAP (Kartoza). Kartoza together with its partners KTH Royal Institute of Technology division of Energy Systems (KTH-dES) and Smart Development Works (SNV) responded to, and were contracted by the WorldBank/ESMAP to carry out the preparation of an Indicative Least-cost Geospatial Electrification Plan to Achieve Universal Access in Benin. Coverage: Benin. It has 38 files in ZIP, GeoJSON. The portal files it under Policies and plans, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
